summary: Repaired the real parent/B04 lock deadlock. At the frozen start, perform_parent_decision held _parent_write_lock and called B04.purchase_drum_kit, which reacquired _purchase_lock then _parent_write_lock; a bounded 120 s subprocess probe timed out. The parent decision now acquires B04's _purchase_lock then _parent_write_lock in the same order as B04 and calls the actual unlocked _purchase_drum_kit inside that composition, preserving decision revalidation and avoiding recursive locking.
